newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see nearby soymeal trade in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see nearby soymeal trade in afternoon.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw some nearby activity in Argentine soymeal pellets this afternoon on calls for a stronger Chicago soymeal futures opening and a slight dip in the dollar, market sources said.
Otherwise little business was reported as the strong dollar kept many buyers sidelined.

"We are coming to the end of the South American crop season and the market gets thinner. With calls for a further rise in Chicago and a dip in the dollar some dealers decided to cover their nearby needs," one broker said.
Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets changed hands between $296 and $286 a tonne cif Rotterdam, depending on position, Jan shipment traded at $286.50 and Feb at $281.50 a tonne cif.
Spot Dutch high protein soymeal traded at $319.50 a tonne fob Rotterdam and arrived Thai tapioca pellets changed hands at 18.75 marks per 100 kg fob Rotterdam.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
